questions.question: What happens when someone types in a document, from the keystroke in the editor to the change appearing for the other people editing it?
questions.note: Runtime hops: app → server is the websocket MultiplayerEditor.tsx opens (line 86, a CollaborationProvider to COLLABORATION_URL/collaboration); server → app is the same socket, the Hocuspocus server in server/services/collaboration.ts (Server.configure line 46, handleConnection line 108) relaying the update.

questions.question: What happens when someone creates a new document from the sidebar, from the click to the document appearing in other people's sidebars?
questions.note: Runtime hops: app → server is HTTP, Store.create posting to /documents.create (app/stores/base/Store.ts line 407); server → app is socket.io, WebsocketsProcessor emitting "entities" (server/queues/processors/WebsocketsProcessor.ts line 58) and WebsocketProvider listening (app/components/WebsocketProvider.tsx line 182).

questions.note: Corrected in Phase 2b (2026-10-28), after reading the tracer's Phase 1 trace, as the Phase 1 review decided: the answer was app → plugins, but the browser navigates to the server's auth route (window.location.href in AuthenticationProvider.tsx line 110, an HTTP request), and the server's auth router mounts the router the Slack plugin registers. This corrects a wrong answer; it is not a loosening to fit the trace. server → app is the HTTP redirect signIn sends (server/utils/authentication.ts lines 185 to 223). server → plugins and plugins → server are imports and stay unmarked.
